What is FBR audit penalty increase?

FBR audit penalty increase refers to the elevated fines imposed by the Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) on taxpayers who fail to comply with tax laws and regulations in Pakistan.

Introduction to FBR Audit Penalty Increases

The FBR has introduced steeper fines for tax non-compliance in the budget 2026-27. This move aims to increase tax revenue and encourage taxpayers to adhere to tax laws. As a result, taxpayers who fail to file their tax returns or pay their taxes on time will face higher penalty amounts. For instance, in Karachi, a taxpayer who fails to file their tax return on time may face a penalty of up to PKR 50,000.

— FBR Compliance Score

Understanding FBR Audit Penalty Increases

To understand FBR audit penalty increases, it is essential to know the different types of penalties imposed by the FBR. These include penalties for late filing, late payment, and non-compliance with tax laws. The FBR IRIS portal provides taxpayers with the facility to file their tax returns and pay their taxes online. However, taxpayers who fail to use this facility or fail to comply with tax laws may face penalties. In Lahore, a taxpayer who fails to pay their taxes on time may face a penalty of up to PKR 100,000.

Common Mistakes that Lead to FBR Audit Penalty Increases

Some common mistakes that lead to FBR audit penalty increases include:

  • Late filing of tax returns
  • Late payment of taxes
  • Non-compliance with tax laws
  • Failure to keep records up-to-date
  • Failure to use the FBR IRIS portal

Deeper Insight into FBR Audit Penalty Increases

The FBR IRIS portal uses API tokens to authenticate users and ensure secure access to taxpayer data. However, these tokens expire after a certain period, and taxpayers must renew them to continue using the portal. This technical detail is crucial for taxpayers who use the FBR IRIS portal to file their tax returns and pay their taxes online.
